reviews.snippet:
I came to share my experience, which I faced during this course and before.
Before enrolling they promised me about the sincere classes, mock and they also told that they will provide the internship.
The classes start too late, which was only on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) only for 2 hours, and when course got started 3-4 classes was good but later, they postpone the class and never took it again, weekly they provide only 2 classes Saturday and Sunday, classes were in Google meet, while taking the classes if any technical glitches occurs and meeting or classes got cut, they'll postpone it to next week, if next there is any festival then they'll postpone it again,  if any small problem occurs they just postpone the classes, in my whole 4 months of this course they only took 9 - 14 classes less than of one hour,
This was the worst course I ever experienced. After the course they didn't even managed the internships, when I called and asked they just delayed it.

After enrollment they'll not care about you guys, so be carefull.
I'm sharing this because I had a worst experience and spent my money on waste platform.
I suggest you guys, whenever you invest your money on course, be aware.
And select a best platform.

I had enrolled for cybersecurity, totally waste.
Complaint For Hubballi branch.

reviews.snippet:
The online seminar by Vijesha IT Company today was honestly a waste of time. They kept saying “raise your hand, first one who raises will get to answer” — and guess what? I raised my hand multiple times, on multiple questions, and they completely ignored it every single time. What’s the point of calling it an interactive internship session on DSA and algorithms if you don’t even bother to acknowledge participants?

The experience was frustrating, unprofessional, and totally disappointing. If you’re not going to follow your own rules or give everyone a fair chance, don’t pretend it's an engaging seminar. I expected better.
